description:
Hi! I’m a student from Kyrgyzstan passionate about space, technology, AI, and innovation. I have experience in leadership, project management, and teamwork. I’m looking for ambitious, creative, and motivated people who are excited about space exploration and ready to turn innovative ideas into reality.

I’m especially looking for teammates with skills in programming, AI, engineering, science, research, and design. You don’t need to be an expert — curiosity, creativity, and commitment matter most
